level_desc.A0: First steps: alphabet, pronunciation, basic words.
level_desc.A1: Basic situations: greetings, shopping, simple questions.
level_desc.A2: Life in Slovakia: renting, work, documents, transport.
level_desc.B1: Confident communication: institutions, doctor, work situations.
level_desc.B2: More complex dialogues: argumentation, correspondence, formal language.
level_desc.C1: Professional communication, nuances and longer texts.
level_desc.C2: Mastery: mediation, style, implicit meaning and official language at near-native level.

plan_outcomes: Get by in shops, cafés and on the street without a translator
Introduce yourself at an interview and work with colleagues
Find your way around a úrad and understand simple forms
Look for a flat, deal with your landlord and read listings
Book a doctor, describe symptoms and buy medicine
Talk to teachers and understand messages from school
Buy tickets and ask for directions
Speak Slovak confidently in everyday life

Vocabulary and mistake practice — review exactly what you forget
Streaks and reminders keep you on track
